correctness.rationale: Contracting prescribed directed successor bonds in a random k-permutation gives exact factorial moments E(R_k)_r=(k-r)/k, including E R_k=1-1/k and E R_k^2=2-3/k. Brown–Peköz–Ross unit-Poisson stochastic domination yields a monotone quantile coupling Y_i>=R_{k,i}; expected gap 1/k, conditional squared gap <=3/k, and chance R_k>0>=4/9. Geometric occupancy of each k and stopped-martingale isometry give cumulative gap O(log n) in L^2; the remaining rounds and idle-indicator differences inherit that bound. For iid Y~Pois(1), Z=1_{Y=0}, q=e^-1, Poisson passage/reward renewal CLT gives covariance [[1,2q],[2q,q+2q^2]], which transfers to ((T_n-n)/sqrt n,(Q_n-qn)/sqrt n) together with moment limits and Q lower coupling. Independent exhaustive k=2..7 successor-permutation counts and factorial moments check: TWO_SHUFFLE_EXACT_PASS. Bounded tests do not establish the infinite Gaussian limit.
